name: Hollow
source:
You play as a girl named Annie who wakes up in a hospital with no memories. In five days, depending on your choice, it may lead her to why she's here. 

[From [url=https://a02nina.itch.io/hollow]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演在医院病床上醒来、失去了全部记忆的少女安妮。在接下来的五天时间里，你的不同选择或将指引她查明自己为何会身处此地。

[摘自[url=https://a02nina.itch.io/hollow]itch.io[/url]]
